> A 20 key PCB Stylophone made using the 10 cent CH32V003 RISC-V microcontroller. It uses the FM8002A to amplify the signal to drive a small speaker. The whole thing is USB powered and functions like the real thing.

## Design

### 2026-10-25 – First entry,

**5.47h**

First entry,

Started on the PCB design. Created the pad footprint. After that placed all of the needed components and started wiring. Continued with the stylus footprint. After that created the PCB outline and spread the components based on their groups, after placing all of them started routing. Added some text where it was needed and that's it!
